title: Evidence or Opinion Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Judge ten review notes as checkable evidence or not evidence yet by looking for a location, an observation, and a rule.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of ten review notes is checkable evidence or not yet evidence, by looking for a location, an observation, and a rule, with at least 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The ideas of evidence for a score and evidence citation

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: What rule was it compared with?
commonMisconceptions: An opinion about the resource is evidence
An AI agent's statement is evidence
assessmentOpportunities: "The alt text is probably fine." Evidence?
"Page 7 link returns an error, tested on 2026-10-12." Evidence?
"The AI agent said the license is CC BY." Evidence?

controls.name: Two bin buttons
controls.description: place the note. The placement is final.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: on a narrow screen the test and bin definitions move behind this button.

controls.name: Play again** and the missed-note review on the results screen.
